description: Executor-authored SCP2-2 DEV cases. The director blind set remains hash-pinned only at config/scp2-2-blind-eval.sha256.

request_texts: Find controlled pass episodes across all configured matches for the home and away teams.
List controlled-pass episodes across all configured matches for both team roles.

For each team and match, report count and per-regain rate for counterattack initiation chains where a regain is followed by a progressive carry of at least 3 metres within 5 seconds and then a controlled pass within 4 seconds.
Measure regains that turn into a 3 metre progressive carry and then a controlled pass, reported as count and per-regain rate by team and match.
Show line breaks where a support option arrives after the receiver crosses the line.
Find controlled line-break support responses where an underneath option arrives after reception.
Count regain to progressive carry to controlled pass chains by team and match.
Report the per-regain rate of regain to progressive carry to controlled pass chains by team and match.
Show completed passes that bypass multiple opponents.

cases.request_text: Find possessions with a progressive corridor available ahead of the ball side.
Show high-bypass completed passes that bypass opponents.
Find first-time relays after the receiver transitions beyond a defensive line.
Build the sequence plus rate ask: regain, then progressive carry of at least 3 metres within 5 seconds, then controlled pass within 4 seconds; report count and rate by team and match.
Show receiving players whose body orientation is open before the pass arrives.
Show the expected completion probability for each pass.
Find moments where the ball carrier intended to bait the press.
Show me the video clips of those counterattack chains.
Show support around possessions using a distance threshold, but the threshold is not specified.
cases.answer: use the default 8 metre support distance
